calculation.description: Compute daily log returns across the 15 tradable assets, subtract the contemporaneous cross-asset mean return, and fade each asset's lagged 10-session cumulative residual return. Scale the reversal symmetrically by lagged 20-session positive-return breadth: extreme broad advances or declines receive more weight. Smooth the resulting signal over three sessions. All inputs are lagged before prediction.
